question_text: The length of a zucchini is normally distributed with mean $24.3\text{ cm}$ and standard deviation $6.83\text{ cm}$. A supermarket buying zucchinis in bulk finds that 15% of them are too small and 20% of them are too large for sale. The remainder, with lengths between $a\text{ cm}$ and $b\text{ cm}$, are able to be sold.

mark_breakdown.desc: Setting up $P(X < a) = 0.15$ and using inverse normal to find $a$
Setting up $P(X > b) = 0.2 \implies P(X \le b) = 0.8$ and using inverse normal

subparts.solution:
$15\%$ of zucchinis are too small.
$P(X < a) = 0.15$
$\therefore a \approx 17.2$

$20\%$ of zucchinis are too large.
$P(X > b) = 0.2$
$\therefore P(X \le b) = 0.8$
$\therefore b \approx 30.0$

ai_explanation.concept_rule: Using Inverse Normal distribution to determine cut-off boundaries for percentiles.
step_by_step: For $a$: $P(X < a) = 0.15$ with $\mu = 24.3, \sigma = 6.83$. Using inverse normal (area = 0.15, tail = left) yields $a \approx 17.22 \approx 17.2$.
For $b$: $P(X > b) = 0.20$, so $P(X \le b) = 0.80$. Using inverse normal (area = 0.80, tail = left) yields $b \approx 30.048 \approx 30.0$.
ai_explanation.common_pitfalls: Forgetting to take $1 - 0.2 = 0.8$ when using left-tailed inverse normal function for $b$.

subparts.stem: A zucchini is chosen at random. Find the probability that it is of saleable length.

mark_breakdown.desc: Using the complement of too small and too large zucchinis: $1 - 0.2 - 0.15$

ai_explanation.concept_rule: Total probability of mutually exclusive regions equals 1.
step_by_step: Recognize that saleable zucchinis are neither too small nor too large.
ai_explanation.common_pitfalls: Recalculating with normal CDF using rounded $a$ and $b$ values rather than direct subtraction.

subparts.stem: A zucchini is chosen at random. Find the probability that its length lies between 20 cm and 26 cm.

mark_breakdown.desc: Setting up normal distribution calculation for $P(20 \le X \le 26)$

ai_explanation.concept_rule: Standard Normal CDF evaluation for a specific interval $[20, 26]$.

subparts.stem: A zucchini is chosen at random. Find the probability that its length is less than 24.3 cm.

mark_breakdown.desc: Recognizing that $24.3$ is the mean $\mu$, so the probability is $0.5$

ai_explanation.concept_rule: Symmetry of the normal distribution about the mean $\mu$.
step_by_step: Observe that the given value $24.3$ is the mean $\mu$.
By symmetry of the normal curve, half the area lies below the mean.
ai_explanation.common_pitfalls: Attempting lengthy calculations rather than using the property of symmetry.
